abt.title: About
abt.subtitle: Application information
abt.storySubtitle: From the author. I just wanted this app to exist.
abt.storyP1: Shiranami started with a simple thought. I didn't want to pay Spotify every month just to keep <1>music looping while I work</1>. So I made my own.
abt.storyP2: It's part of the Shiro Suite, a small set of tools I'm building. Three are public so far: <1>Shiranami · ShiroAni · KireiManga</1>. Each one does one thing the way I wanted it to work.
abt.storyP3: I like building tools that work for me, and they end up working for someone else too. If that's you, <1>thanks for being here</1>.
abt.logsSubtitle: Open the log folder in your file explorer
abt.replaySubtitle: Step through the first-run setup again

sup.title: Support
sup.subtitle: From the author. If Shiranami earns a spot in your day.
sup.p1: Shiranami is free, has no ads, and never will. I build it in my spare time because I wanted <1>a player that just plays</1>: no account, no subscription, no noise.
sup.p2: If it's become part of your routine and you'd like to give a little back, you can <1>buy me a coffee</1>. It's completely optional and means more than you'd think.
sup.p3: Either way, whether you chip in or just keep listening, <1>thanks for being here</1>.
